card.title: PlayStation 5 Blue Light of Death (BLOD) and APU Diagnostics

claims.statement: Pulsating blue light of death indicates the console is stuck running hardware checks, frequently pointing to APU, RAM, or shorted power rails.
claims.evidence: Diagnostic behavior pattern of BLOD on PS5.
claims.quote: Check board with thermal camera to check for shorts. Problem could be anything. It is like a generic error code. Is keeps pulsating because it keeps running checks.

claims.statement: A console that beeps once every 5-10 seconds when pressing the power button can indicate a short on the board.
claims.evidence: Acoustic symptom correlated with hardware shorts.
claims.quote: 1 beep every 5-10 seconds when pressing power button can indicate a short.

procedure: Inspect the mainboard and APU for liquid metal spills or displacement under seals.
Probe all power rails in diode mode to identify dead shorts.
Use a thermal camera during power-on to locate hot spots or failing components.
card.caveats: BLOD is a generic symptom; further electrical measurements are always required.
